ledger.note: 808: 'Lintel 10 is the last known monument at Yaxchilan, dating to 808'; in the same year K'inich Tatb'u Skull III captured Piedras Negras's Ruler 7. The infobox gives 'Abandoned: 900 AD' and 'the dynasty lasted into the early 9th century'.

wars.name: Yaxchilan-Piedras Negras wars
wars.outcome: 460 Moon Skull's victory over Piedras Negras; about 478 Bird Jaguar II captured a vassal of its king; 514 Knot-eye Jaguar I captured by Ruler C; 726 Yaxchilan defeated by Piedras Negras (Stela 8; 727 on that page); 759 Yaxchilan 'gaining a victory over its enemy'; 808 K'inich Tatb'u Skull III captured K'inich Yat Ahk II, 'ending dynastic rule there and destroying the city as a capital'. No land change is dated.
wars.note: The Piedras Negras page gives 727 for its victory and 808 for Ruler 7's capture.

wars.name: Yaxchilan's captures of Lacanha lords
wars.outcome: 'Knot-eye Jaguar II is known to have captured the lord of Lacanha in 564' and 'In 729, Itzamnaaj B'alam II captured Aj Popol Chay, the lord of Lacanha'. The page does not say Lacanha became a dependency.

sources.title: Yaxchilan
sources.note: Dynasty from 23 July 359; Piedras Negras wars 460, 514, 726, 759, 808; Lacanha captures 564 and 729; Bonampak c.790; Lintel 10 of 808; infobox built 300-900, abandoned 900.

sources.title: Piedras Negras (Maya site)
sources.note: Read for the Yaxchilan wars from the other side (727, 808).

notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no Yaxchilan row.
DATES. Start is the page's 'most likely 23 July 359'. End 808 is Lintel 10; the infobox says abandoned 900 and the page says the dynasty 'lasted into the early 9th century'. The 808 capture of Piedras Negras's king is by K'inich Tatb'u Skull III (the Piedras Negras page calls the captor Skull III and Skull IV in different sections).
SPELLING. The page reads 'Yopaat B'alam'.
COUNTERPARTS. Bonampak and Lacanha have no dossiers. Gazetteer lacks 'Yaxchilan'; 'Bonampak' is used as a place name and may not resolve.
